arithmetic.source_literals: Decimal.from_float(float(literal)); exact-real binary64 values, then Decimal arithmetic

primary_kernel.method: Explicit adaptation of read PHYS26 degree-three log Taylor jet, same original HI fit, k and k-prime only

independent_kernel.method: Separately expressed scalar original-fit log derivative ell1,ell2,ell3; no Jet or finite difference
independent_kernel.shared_dependencies: Original HI fit, source-real constants, J, Decimal transcendental operations; not independent physical data

quadrature.distinct_order: Gauss-Legendre 24 points at 7 selected centers only
quadrature.nodes: Decimal polynomial recurrence and Newton roots, binary64 cosine seeds only; 20 positive node solves total, 30 iterations max each; reflected exact +/- pairs
quadrature.polynomial_validation: For order n check every degree 0..2n-1 against integral[-1,1] x^d; positive weights and distinct supported nodes; scaled tolerance 1e-60
quadrature.independent_rule: Composite Simpson 32/64/128 panels from common 129-point scalar grid per selected center; R6_64=(16*S64-S32)/15, R6_128=(16*S128-S64)/15, R8=(64*R6_128-R6_64)/63
quadrature.normalization_check: Simpson mean factor 1/(3n); Gauss mean factor 1/2; raw moments normalize weights to integral=2

rule: moving upper center at physical W=19.74
moving lower center at physical W=19.74

physical_root_searches.algorithm: Sign-preserving bisection for 80 iterations; stop earlier only if finite Decimal F equals exactly zero; evaluate final midpoint and retain full iteration history
physical_root_searches.scope: No inherited root search is rerun

physical_variance_cases.endpoints: Explicit V=0 and V=L_delta*H_delta avoid reintroducing Decimal repeating-offset roundoff at degenerate supports

checks.moments: Direct integrate each uniform band for mass, mean, central variance, raw second moment; compare center variance+delta^2/3, total N0, total N0*m
checks.response: Explicit moment-bound formulas vs band-weight sums; degenerate endpoints, strict internal gap, strict containment in original delta-allowed same-W bounds at 9 samples
checks.quadrature: Compare kbar and kbar-prime GL16 vs GL24 and independent scalar Simpson/R8 at 7 centers; monotone raw Simpson refinement; not proof of continuum or enclosure
checks.mixtures: Quarter-upper and zero-response weight mixture at physical W19.74, actual 4-band moments and residual retained
checks.local_root_conditioning: Root-local response derivative from secant/tangent formula, and linearized displacement from independent quadrature difference; diagnostic only, not error bound

tolerances.raw_Simpson_refinement: Strict decreasing observed absolute error at 32,64,128

claim_ceiling: Numerical quadrature agreement and finite bisection brackets are not directed interval enclosures.
Report new thresholds at most 12 significant digits; extra stored Decimal digits are reproducibility data only.
No J, atomic, gas or physical uncertainty enclosure; fixed serialized J and source-real constants only.
Uniform-band family only; no all-continuous-spectra or physical-source admission.
All-W continuum inequalities and equality conditions require the separate theory derivation.
No finite-time/finite-epsilon remainder, native equivalence, production source change or novelty claim.

independence.parent_design_suggestions_read: Decimal + quadrature alternatives, fixed budgets, nine-case and seven-center selection hints
independence.theory_prior_exposure: Parent relayed exact containment prediction and threshold-shift directions before any science; this is not blind prediction testing

failure_policy: Preserve first raw stdout/stderr/exit and first result even if any check fails; no tolerance relaxation or hidden rerun.
